adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, the recurring+allRemainingBookings branch still iterates over bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(type.endsWith('_calendar')) and, for each updated booking, only deletes the first calendar reference via updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes('_calendar')). This ignores the per-reference credentialId/externalCalendarId being processed in the outer `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` loop, and it cannot target team hosts’ calendar credentials/references when a collective booking produces multiple calendar references. As a result, team hosts’ calendar events can be left undeleted on recurring cancellation.
